items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Alexander. He was playing, too.

ctx.x: You’re talking about – not the legendary – I want to think. This is the tenor player that’s like the legend of Cleveland. I know exactly who you’re talking about.

items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: No. He’s an older guy. Muslim. Plays with a big sound.
